fundingScope: Per-firm own opening stock versus received payments. Incoming customer receipts can themselves originate from other opening stocks, including the new retirement funding. They are not claimed to be independent earned national income. No direct added opening cash or loan was admitted to any of these 27 firms.
attributionStatus: Exact source-by-expense chronological traces were not retained in the five snapshots. Where receipts are zero, actual paid wages and purchases are necessarily opening-funded. Elsewhere only conservative funding bounds are established. Bounds for wages and purchases are individually conservative and must not be added as if both extremes occur together.
boundMethod: At each saved date, cumulative outflows exceeding cumulative receipts require original opening cash. The largest such deficit bounds the minimum opening-funded total. The maximum is no greater than original opening cash or total outflows. Analogous conservative category bounds use wage/purchase deficits; receipt-funded bounds are the complement. This is reconstruction from saved stock/flow accounting, not an actual causal trace.
